subject.title: fix(msteams): bound Microsoft Graph API response reads in graph-upload to prevent OOM

question: Should this PR land the shared 16 MiB fail-closed JSON cap for successful Microsoft Graph upload, share, driveItem, chat-list, and chat-member responses in the bundled MS Teams plugin?
rationale: The code change is narrow and well-proven, but it changes a shipped external-response success path from unbounded buffering to a labelled error when a successful JSON body exceeds the shared provider cap.

options.title: Accept the shared cap
options.body: Merge with the current 16 MiB bounded-reader behavior and treat unusually large successful Graph metadata as a fail-closed error.

options.title: Request live tenant proof
options.body: Ask for a Microsoft 365 tenant upload/share smoke if service-specific confidence is required beyond the loopback reader proof.

options.title: Defer for one MS Teams response-size policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide one cap/error policy across the adjacent MS Teams upload, SSO, collection, and attachment metadata bounded-read PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared cap
recommendation.body: Merge with the current 16 MiB bounded-reader behavior and treat unusually large successful Graph metadata as a fail-closed error.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a compatibility/security tradeoff in a shipped bundled plugin, and steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current history and repository ownership evidence.
